name: How to Plan Your Berkeley Home Remodel

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Ready to give your East Bay home a fresh look? Planning a home remodel can feel like a huge task, but breaking it down makes it much more manageable. First things first, get clear on what you actually want to achieve. What are your goals and priorities for this space? Do you need more function, better aesthetics, or both?

step.name: Step 2
step.text: Once you have a vision, it’s time to set a realistic budget. And when I say realistic, I mean it! Don't just guess; dig into what things actually cost and remember to build in a little extra for unexpected surprises. Next, you'll need a clear renovation plan that outlines every step. Think about creating a schedule with key milestones—things like material selections, demolition, and inspections.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Communication is key throughout the whole process. Establish routines for checking in with your contractor and make sure you understand how any changes to the plan or budget will be handled. Ordering long-lead items, like custom cabinets or special-order tiles, early can prevent annoying delays down the road. If your project involves multiple trades, permits, or potential structural changes, that's often when a professional like Frasheski Construction can really help coordinate everything smoothly. They’re based right here in Berkeley and know the ropes.
